title: Semantic Kernel Process Framework
description: Build multi-step agent pipelines with the SK Process Framework (ProcessBuilder, steps, and edges) instead of the deprecated SequentialPlanner.

blocks.text: SequentialPlanner and StepwisePlanner were deprecated in Semantic Kernel v1.19+ and removed in v2.0. The current SK v1.25+ replacement is the Process Framework, which defines steps, edges, and agents as composable processes using ProcessBuilder.

blocks.title: Core types
items: ProcessStep - a single unit of work, often implemented with [KernelFunction].
ProcessEdge - connects steps and controls flow.

blocks.title: Order process with ProcessBuilder
blocks.content: Modern SK v1.25+ multi-step agent pipeline using ProcessBuilder.

blocks.title: SequentialPlanner is gone
blocks.text: Do not use SequentialPlanner or StepwisePlanner in new code. Use ProcessBuilder for complex multi-step flows, or a hand-rolled function-calling loop with KernelArguments for simpler plan-and-execute patterns.

points: Process Framework is the SK v1.25+ replacement for planners.

blocks.takeaway: Use ProcessBuilder for complex multi-step agent workflows in Semantic Kernel v1.25+.
